request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change only the darkest parts of his skin: the very dark green arms, hands, legs, feet and ear shadows become the same medium green as his face and chest, with only a slightly darker green shadow tone, so his whole body is clearly one medium leaf green. Keep everything else exactly the same: the orange-brown leather cap, crossed straps and loincloth, the belt, wrist bands, dagger, eyes, teeth, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
